Remediation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east rolled over), leaving a mixed version state; a retry completed the rollout. Service is now on v2.3.0 in all regions and healthy (error rate ~0.2%). v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is investigated.
